title: Estágio em Automação - Remoto
description:
At UL, we know why we come to work.
Thousands of us around the world wake up every day with a common purpose: to make the world a safer, more secure and sustainable place. Science is in our DNA; we are endlessly curious and passionate about seeking and speaking the truth. We take delight in knowing that our work makes a meaningful contribution to society, and we are proud that our culture is centered on integrity, collaboration, inclusion and excellence. UL stands at the forefront of technological advancement, and we are continually challenged to find new ways to foster innovation and positive change. Satisfying? Yes. Exciting? Absolutely!
What you’ll learn & achieve:
  • Work with automation – BOT's (development, testing, maintenance, release)
  • Collaborate with the automation team to identify and analyze potential automation opportunities within various business processes
  • Participate in the testing and troubleshooting of automation workflows to ensure they meet quality and efficiency standards
  • Support QA in admin tasks.
What makes you a great fit:
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Analysis and Systems Development or related
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office
  • Fluent or Advanced English is required
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Power automate
  • Knowledge of Microsoft software
  • Knowledge of programming (Python, Java – Intermediate, Microsoft Office, Excel) – differential.
  • Must be willing to commit to a 6h/day journey.
What you’ll experience working at UL:
  • Mission: For UL Solutions, corporate and social responsibility isn’t new. Making the world a safer, more secure and sustainable place has been our business model for over 125 years and is deeply engrained in everything we do.
  • People: Ask any UL Solutions employee what they love most about working here, and you’ll almost always hear, “the people.” Going beyond what is possible is the standard at UL Solutions. We’re able to deliver the best because we employ the best.
  • Interesting work: Every day is different for us here as we eagerly anticipate the next innovation that our customers create. We’re inspired to take on the challenge that will transform how people live, work and play. And as a global company, in many roles, you will get international experience working with colleagues around the world.
  • Grow & achieve: We learn, work and grow together with targeted development, reward and recognition programs as well as our very own UL University that offers extensive training programs for employees at all stages, including a technical training track for applicable roles.
Learn More:
Working at UL is an exciting journey that twists and turns daily. We thrive in the twists and revel in the turns. This is our every day. This is our normal.
Curious? To learn more about us and the work we do, visit UL.com

title: Vendas internacionais
description:
Buscamos um profissional atuar na área comercial internacional de uma indústria brasileira de soluções tecnológicas. Se você possui forte perfil comercial orientado a resultados e experiência em abertura de novos mercados, essa vaga é para você!

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES:

Executar o plano anual de vendas para mercados externos, definindo KPIs estratégicos.

Prospectar e abrir novos mercados, desenvolvendo parcerias com importadores e distribuidores globais.

Conduzir fechamentos comerciais estratégicos no exterior.

Seguir tendêcias e regulamentações internacionais para garantir a competitividade dos produtos.

PRÉ-REQUISITOS:

Ensino Superior completo em Gestão Comercial, Negócios Internacionais, Relações Internacionais, Administração ou áreas correlatas. (Mínimo cursando)

Inglês Avançado (essencial para negociações) e Espanhol Intermediário.

Experiência comprovada em vendas internacionais e vivência no setor industrial.

Possuir CNH e veículo próprio.

Disponibilidade total para viagens nacionais e internacionais.

PACOTE:

Modelo: 100% Home Office (Pode residir em qualquer lugar do Brasil).

Regime: PJ - Prestador de Serviços.

Remuneração: Valor Fixo + Variável (A negociar)

title: Product Owner
description:
VAGA ABERTA: Product Owner Sênior – Remoto


Em busca de uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza a flexibilidade, desenvolvimento pessoal e sucesso da equipe? Com 30 anos de experiência e reconhecidos pelo GPTW pelo quinto ano consecutivo, estamos em busca de talentos para se juntarem a nós como Product Owner . Com matriz no Brasil e filiais em território internacional, oferecemos oportunidades para crescimento e desenvolvimento. Candidate-se agora e faça parte de uma equipe que transforma negócios e realiza sonhos!


Requisitos essenciais:


  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner ou em função equivalente atuando com times técnicos;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis como SAFe, Scrum e Kanban, participando ativamente de cerimônias e refinamentos;
  • Capacidade de estruturar, organizar e priorizar backlog equilibrando demandas estruturantes e necessidades de negócio;
  • Experiência na gestão de fluxo puxado, identificação de gargalos e tratamento de dependências técnicas;
  • Domínio de métricas de fluxo de trabalho, como Lead Time, Cycle Time, Throughput, WIP, Aging WIP e previsibilidade, aplicando-as no balanceamento da capacidade do time;
  • Habilidade para tomar decisões orientadas por dados, convertendo métricas em ações de melhoria contínua;
  • Facilidade no uso de ferramentas de gestão e planejamento, especialmente Jira Cloud ou Azure DevOps;
  • Capacidade de equilibrar prioridades considerando urgências, estratégia do produto e capacidade produtiva da equipe;
  • Experiência na comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio, assegurando alinhamento de expectativas;
  • Alto nível de organização e controle de demandas, atuando com clareza, responsabilidade e senso de propriedade mesmo sob pressão;
  • Excelente comunicação, habilidade de mediação entre stakeholders e postura estratégica, protagonista e confortável em ambientes complexos.


Requisitos adicionais:


  • Experiência prévia em ambientes de infraestrutura crítica ou junto a times de Engenharia, como Telecom, DevOps, Segurança ou SRE;
  • Formação ou background em tecnologia ou engenharia de software, com compreensão de dependências técnicas e arquiteturais;
  • Conhecimento e experiência prática com inteligência artificial.


Responsabilidades:


  • Organizar e manter o backlog atualizado e alinhado às prioridades técnicas e de negócio;
  • Priorizar itens do backlog considerando dependências técnicas, riscos e impacto no produto;
  • Monitorar métricas de fluxo de trabalho e atuar para otimizar entregas e reduzir gargalos;
  • Garantir visibilidade das entregas e comunicação transparente do progresso aos stakeholders;
  • Facilitar decisões estratégicas em conjunto com times técnicos e áreas de negócio;
  • Colaborar de forma próxima com equipes de plataforma, infraestrutura, DevOps, Telecom, Segurança e SRE;
  • Apoiar a definição de critérios de aceitação e qualidade, assegurando consistência nas entregas;
  • Manter comunicação fluida entre equipes técnicas e liderança de produto.


Nossos cuidados com você:

*Benefícios a variar de acordo com a modalidade de contrato


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição Ifood Empresas;

Benefício indireto (valor fixo para custeio parcial do plano de saúde ou somado ao vale alimentação);

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Sys Manager - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Auxílio Creche;

Assistência Médica;

title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Please share your resume in English.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Analista de Relações com Investidores e ESG III
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Helbor Empreendimentos S.A. é uma das incorporadoras mais tradicionais do mercado imobiliário brasileiro, com mais de quatro décadas de atuação. Companhia aberta listada no Novo Mercado da B3 , a Helbor tem como compromisso a transparência, a ética e a criação de valor sustentável para seus acionistas e para a sociedade.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Sênior de Relações com Investidores e ESG para integrar nossa área de RI, atuando diretamente no suporte às atividades de comunicação com o mercado de capitais e no fortalecimento da agenda de sustentabilidade da companhia.

A área de Relações com Investidores possui papel estratégico na companhia, sendo responsável pela interface com investidores, analistas de mercado, órgãos reguladores e demais stakeholders, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e transparência das informações divulgadas ao mercado.

Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil analítico, organizado(a), com excelente capacidade de comunicação e interesse em mercado de capitais e temas relacionados a ESG. A pessoa selecionada terá a oportunidade de atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com alto nível de exposição a temas estratégicos da companhia e contato direto com diferentes áreas internas e participantes do mercado.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Apoiar a elaboração e revisão de materiais de divulgação ao mercado, como Release de Resultados, Apresentações Institucionais, Formulário de Referência e Relatórios Anuais;
  • Apoiar a preparação e organização de conference calls, reuniões com investidores, analistas e roadshows;
  • Interagir com diversas áreas internas (Contabilidade, Controladoria, Jurídico, Planejamento e Operações) para coleta e consolidação de informações para divulgação ao mercado;
  • Auxiliar no monitoramento de indicadores operacionais e financeiros da companhia e de seus pares;
  • Apoiar o acompanhamento de temas regulatórios relacionados ao mercado de capitais;
  • Participar da elaboração e acompanhamento de iniciativas relacionadas à agenda ESG;
  • Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios e questionários de sustentabilidade, bem como no relacionamento com agências de rating ESG;
  • Auxiliar no acompanhamento da percepção do mercado sobre a companhia e na elaboração de análises de mercado e benchmarking com empresas do setor;
  • Contribuir para o aprimoramento contínuo das práticas de transparência e governança da companhia.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia em Relações com Investidores, mercado de capitais, equity research, consultorias ou áreas financeiras;
  • Conhecimento sobre demonstrações financeiras e indicadores econômico-financeiros;
  • Familiaridade com rotinas de companhias abertas e regulamentação aplicável;
  • Interesse ou experiência com temas relacionados a ESG e sustentabilidade corporativa;
  • Inglês avançado (especialmente para leitura e comunicação escrita);
  • Excel e PowerPoint em nível avançado;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado, com atenção a detalhes e boa capacidade de comunicação escrita e verbal.


Informações adicionais

O que nós oferecemos:


  • Vale Alimentação
  • Vale Refeição
  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Participação nos Resultados
  • Wellhub
  • Zenklub
  • Espaço de descompressão equipado com vídeo games, ping pong e espaço para alimentação


Onde estamos: Faria Lima - SP

title: Tech Recruiter
description:
Estamos em busca de Tech Recruiter Sênior para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratação Brasil da AI/R Company , grupo que reúne empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL.


Você será responsável por:


  • Conduzir o processo de recrutamento de tecnologia de ponta a ponta ;
  • Realizar hunting ativo e geração de pipeline qualificado;
  • Conduzir entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais de forma estruturada, garantindo aderência cultural e técnica;
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com líderes e stakeholders, atuando de forma consultiva;
  • Alimentar e gerenciar informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter , garantindo a qualidade dos dados;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de performance (KPIs) e propor melhorias nos processos de recrutamento.


O que você precisa ter:


  • Sólida experiência como Tech Recruiter em consultorias ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Domínio de LinkedIn Recruiter e ferramentas de sourcing (boolean search, AI tools, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em perfis técnicos (Desenvolvedores, QA, DevOps, Data, Machine Learning, etc.);
  • Experiência com métricas de recrutamento (taxa de conversão, tempo de fechamento);
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e colaborativa , em ambiente remoto e dinâmico.
  • Habilidades de negociação, comunicação e resiliência.



A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Desenvolvedor Sênior - C/C++
description:
Código da vaga: 59230


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei #fera em desenvolvimento, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um(a) #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência em desenvolvimento com C/C++
  • Habilidades com AWS, Linux, Python, Terraform, CI/CD e SQL.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira!


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Software Engineer in Test
description:
Quality Platform Engineer (Remote – Brazil, CLT)


QAT Global , a US-based IT consulting firm with 30+ years of experience , is looking for a Quality Platform Engineer to support a US-based customer.

You will collaborate with development teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil , building and operating the infrastructure that powers automated testing.


About the Role

We are looking for a Quality Platform Engineer to design, build, and operate the platform that executes automated testing at scale.

While Quality Engineers focus on writing tests, this role ensures those tests run reliably, efficiently, and consistently across environments .

You will work closely with QA, Engineering, and DevOps teams , owning the infrastructure and systems that power automated test execution.

This role also supports automation frameworks using Playwright and performance testing using JMeter .


Responsibilities:


  • Design and maintain containerized environments used for automated testing
  • Build and operate scalable test execution platforms supporting parallel and isolated test runs
  • Ensure consistent behavior across local, CI, and pre-release environments
  • Design and maintain GitHub Actions workflows for automated testing in the SDLC
  • Integrate automated testing into the release and deployment process
  • Support automation frameworks using Playwright and performance testing using JMeter
  • Improve reliability, performance, and observability of automated test pipelines
  • Build systems for test result aggregation, artifacts, and failure analysis
  • Identify and reduce test flakiness and pipeline instability
  • Enable Quality Engineers through clear execution interfaces and documentation


Required Experience:


  • Strong experience with CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions preferred)
  • Hands-on experience with Docker or container-based execution environments
  • Experience supporting automated test execution platforms or CI runners
  • Experience supporting automation frameworks such as Playwright
  • Experience supporting performance testing execution (JMeter preferred)
  • Strong scripting/programming skills (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Bash, or similar )
  • Solid understanding of modern software architectures and automated testing strategies
  • Experience with parallel test execution, test sharding, or ephemeral environments
  • Experience analyzing failures in CI pipelines or automated test runs
  • Comfortable working across QA, DevOps, and Engineering teams
  • Strong English communication skills


Preferred Qualifications:


  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Systems Analysis, Computer Engineering , or related field
company: QAT Global | Custom Software Development & IT Staffing Solutions - US, Brazil & Costa Rica Nearshore

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
Who we are

We’re a passionate engineering, platform, and operations team, developing and supporting ground-breaking products. Together, we’ll build for the future, creating more opportunities for wellness businesses around the world to help their customers lead full, healthy lives. We push ourselves and our company to always strive for this higher purpose, recognizing the power in working together toward the same goal. We believe in building a diverse company where everyone feels safe bringing their authentic selves to work. And we believe that the secret to success is our people. Join the team, and let’s see what we can accomplish together!


Your role

As an Engineering Manager, you’ll be leading a full stack or backend team focused on one of the key opportunities for Playlist.


You will:

  • Empower your engineering team to deliver a high level of technical quality and business impact.
  • Recruit a diverse team of engineers that are amongst the best in the industry, from outreach to closing.
  • Manage a team of engineers and help develop their careers with stretch responsibilities and excellent feedback.
  • Be actively involved in strategic direction and product decisions for your team.
  • Contribute to engineering-wide initiatives as a member of Playlist's engineering management team.


About the right team member

You are an experienced engineer turned successful people leader who is passionate about creating impactful and high-quality web applications. You have deep experience in at least one aspect of developing a world class web application and you can manage a high performing team through the entire process.


You’ll thrive in this role with experience in:

  • 3+ years of directly managing a full stack or backend engineering team of at least 6 people.
  • Experience shipping high quality websites or mobile applications.
  • You have established the architecture and best practices for web or mobile applications and their backends.
  • You have a proven ability to establish and articulate a vision, set goals, develop and execute.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
Unidade de Negócio: Gringo & Zapay


Modelo de trabalho: Remoto


Objetivos do cargo que você irá atuar: Como Staff Engineer você será uma referência técnica transversal, com forte influência sobre decisões arquiteturais, padrões de engenharia e evolução da plataforma que sustenta todos os times de produto.

Você não estará focado em uma squad específica, mas sim em elevar o sistema como um todo: confiabilidade, escalabilidade, segurança, developer experience e eficiência operacional.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Influenciar e guiar decisões arquiteturais de médio e longo prazo da plataforma
  • Definir e evoluir padrões técnicos para serviços, infraestrutura, observabilidade e CI/CD
  • Atuar como guardião da qualidade técnica, reduzindo complexidade e dívida técnica
  • Trabalhar próximo a Tech Leads, SREs e Tech Managers, ajudando a desambiguar decisões difíceis
  • Projetar e evoluir plataformas e serviços compartilhados (infra, pipelines, templates, SDKs, ferramentas internas)
  • Garantir alta confiabilidade, escalabilidade e segurança dos sistemas em produção
  • Atuar fortemente em observabilidade, troubleshooting e resposta a incidentes críticos
  • Promover uma excelente Developer Experience, melhorando fluxos de build, deploy, testes e operação
  • Mentorar engenheiros(as) de diferentes níveis, elevando o padrão técnico da organização
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas elegantes, incrementais e sustentáveis
  • Tomar decisões orientadas por métricas, dados e impacto real no negócio


Requisitos e qualificações


É imprescindível que você tenha:


  • Experiência sólida como engenheiro(a) sênior / staff / principal
  • Forte domínio em Node.js e Typescript.
  • Experiência profunda com arquitetura de microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos
  • Sólido conhecimento em Kubernetes e ambientes cloud (GCP/AWS/Azure)
  • Excelente domínio de observabilidade, troubleshooting e sistemas em produção
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis)
  • Vivência com CI/CD, automação e infraestrutura como código
  • Forte capacidade de comunicação, influência e mentoria
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas complexas equilibrando negócio, engenharia e operação


Não obrigatório, mas será incrível se você:


  • Já atuou fortemente em times de plataforma ou SRE
  • Já trabalhou em projetos de grande porte utilizando Python
  • Tem experiência com arquiteturas event-driven
  • Conhece e aplica DDD, Clean Architecture e Ports & Adapters
  • Já liderou iniciativas transversais de engenharia
  • Consegue explicar decisões técnicas complexas de forma simples


Informações adicionais


Fique por dentro do que te oferecemos:

  • Assistência Médica (SulAmérica)
  • Assistência Odontológica (Bradesco)
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass) – com extensão para até 3 dependentes
  • Telemedicina 24h – consultas online por chamada de vídeo, disponíveis todos os dias da semana
  • Isenção na mensalidade do SEM PARAR – para 1 veículo no plano Tag Imparável
  • Vale-Alimentação ou Vale-Refeição – você escolhe a melhor opção:
  • VA para compras em supermercados
  • VR para uso em restaurantes no dia a dia
  • Day-off de aniversário (pessoal e da empresa)
  • Programa de acompanhamento para gestantes e licença-paternidade estendida
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio-Creche
  • Auxílio para dependente PCD
  • PLR

title: Coordenador de Expansão
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Coordenador de Expansão para fazer parte do nosso time na VAROS Consultoria.


A VAROS é uma das principais empresas do mercado financeiro brasileiro, com atuação nas áreas de Wealth Management, Research e Educação. Nós valorizamos o esforço e premiamos o resultado, aplicando um modelo de partnership que permite a rápida ascensão dos colaboradores dentro da empresa.


Como Coordenador de Expansão do braço de Consultoria você será responsável por captar novos consultores de investimento para fazer parte do time da VAROS. Você ficará incumbido por todo o processo de recrutamento e seleção destes profissionais, mantendo uma rotina diária de prospecção de novos contatos e relacionamento com contatos atuais.


Atividades

  • Recrutamento e Prospecção de Consultores: Identificar, atrair e recrutar profissionais qualificados do mercado financeiro para atuarem como consultores de investimento na VAROS. Mapear talentos em corretoras, assets, bancos e escritórios de assessoria, utilizando sua rede de contatos e estratégias ativas de hunting;
  • Gestão do Pipeline de Candidatos: Estruturar e operar um funil de recrutamento completo: prospecção, abordagem, entrevistas, negociação e onboarding. Acompanhar métricas como volume de abordagens, taxa de conversão por etapa, tempo médio de contratação e custo por contratação;
  • Expansão Estratégica: Desenvolver e executar o plano de expansão do time de consultores, alinhado às metas de crescimento da VAROS. Identificar praças e regiões com maior potencial, priorizar mercados e definir metas de contratação por período;
  • Relacionamento com o Mercado: Manter e ampliar uma rede ativa de relacionamentos com profissionais do mercado financeiro, participando de eventos, comunidades e fóruns do setor. Ser a principal ponte entre a VAROS e talentos do mercado;
  • Gestão de Pessoas: Liderar o processo de integração dos novos consultores, garantindo alinhamento com a cultura e os padrões da VAROS. Coordenar um time de apoio à expansão conforme a operação escalar;


Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada no mercado financeiro. Você precisa já estar inserido no ecossistema de assessoria de investimentos, corretoras e gestoras por dentro;
  • Rede de contatos sólida e ativa com profissionais do mercado financeiro. Se você não conhece gente, essa vaga não é para você;
  • Histórico de atuação com recrutamento, hunting ou desenvolvimento de equipes comerciais no segmento financeiro;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia total. Você vai receber uma meta de expansão e precisará estruturar o plano e executar sem microgerenciamento;
  • Habilidade de comunicação e persuasão. Você vai convencer profissionais bem posicionados no mercado a mudarem de casa — isso exige argumentação forte e leitura de perfil;
  • Perfil relacional e executor. Você decolará nessa vaga se souber abrir portas com facilidade e, ao mesmo tempo, conseguir tocar o processo do começo ao fim sozinho. O time dará escala assim que a operação for validada;


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em escritórios de assessoria de investimentos (XP, BTG, ou similares);
  • Vivência com estruturação de operações de expansão ou abertura de novos escritórios/filiais;
  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas ou coordenação de times comerciais no mercado financeiro;


O que oferecemos

  • Remuneração competitiva e bônus por performance;

title: Founding General Manager / Operating Partner
description:
About CoHostly

CoHostly is a growing SaaS company focused on building software and systems that solve real operational problems in the rental car space. We are looking for a high-level operator who can help turn a fast-moving company into a more structured, scalable business.

This is not a normal job. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to help build something meaningful from the ground up and work directly with the founder to drive execution, growth, and long-term value.


About the role

We are hiring a Founding General Manager / Operating Partner to help lead execution across the business. This person will help bring structure, accountability, and momentum to CoHostly while taking a major load off the founder.

This role is ideal for someone who is strong in operations, growth, sales support, team coordination, and making things happen in early-stage environments.


What you’ll be responsible for

  • Help run day-to-day execution across the business
  • Build structure, systems, and accountability around priorities
  • Coordinate projects across product, operations, sales, and growth
  • Work closely with the founder to turn ideas into execution
  • Help manage contractors, remote team members, and key initiatives
  • Support customer onboarding, retention, and feedback loops
  • Help identify bottlenecks, solve problems, and keep the company moving fast
  • Create visibility around KPIs, priorities, and weekly progress
  • Contribute to growth efforts including partnerships, outbound support, and business development initiatives


Who we’re looking for

  • Strong operator with experience in startups, SaaS, fintech, marketplaces, or high-growth businesses
  • Highly organized and execution-focused
  • Able to work directly with a founder and thrive in a fast-moving environment
  • Strong communicator who can manage moving pieces and drive progress
  • Comfortable wearing multiple hats across ops, growth, sales support, and team coordination
  • Resourceful, proactive, and able to solve problems without constant direction
  • Serious about building, not just collecting a paycheck


Preferred background

  • Experience working in a startup or early-stage company
  • Experience in business operations, product operations, general management, chief of staff, or growth
  • Experience helping scale teams, systems, or revenue
  • Experience managing remote teams or contractors
  • Bonus if you have experience in SaaS, fintech, automotive, fleet, or marketplace businesses


What success looks like

In the first 90 days, you should be able to:

  • create more structure and accountability across the business
  • improve execution speed
  • organize priorities and workflows
  • help move key growth and product initiatives forward
  • increase revenue and sales
  • make the company easier to run and easier to scale


Compensation

Compensation will depend on experience and background. This role includes base compensation with performance-based upside. Long-term incentive or equity potential may be available for the right person after proven execution.


How to apply

Please send:

  • your resume
  • a short intro about your background
  • 2–3 examples of similar work you’ve done
  • a brief explanation of why you’re a strong fit for this role

We are looking for someone sharp, reliable, and high-level. Remote is fine. Overseas is fine. What matters most is that you can execute.

title: Desenvolvedor C++
description:
Cód. 59232


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei Dev, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Desenvolvimento avançado em C/C++ (atuação direta no core transacional de autorizador de cartões).
  • Experiência em AWS (nível intermediário) para apoiar/implementar a modernização e migração da plataforma para cloud.
  • Conhecimentos intermediários de Linux (operação, troubleshooting e ambiente de execução).
  • Automação e infraestrutura como código : Terraform + práticas de CI/CD (nível intermediário).
  • Suporte ao ecossistema de desenvolvimento e dados : Python e SQL (nível intermediário), além de boa colaboração/proatividade e foco em performance/risco.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Product Manager
description:
About the Role

We’re building an AI-driven product and looking for a Product Manager to help shape our roadmap and deliver great user experiences. You’ll work closely with the founder, designer, and engineering team to define priorities, plan releases, and bring ideas to life. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both strategy and execution in a fast-moving startup.


Responsibilities

  • Define and communicate product vision, goals, and priorities.
  • Translate user needs and business objectives into clear requirements.
  • Collaborate managing directly engineering to plan, build, and ship features.
  • Manage the product backlog, ensuring alignment with team capacity and goals.
  • Analyze feedback and data to inform decisions and measure outcomes.
  • Keep clear, async communication across a distributed team.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager (ideally in startups or SaaS environments).
  • Strong understanding of product development cycles and agile practices.
  • Experience collaborating closely with engineering and design teams.
  • Analytical mindset with good judgment for prioritization.
  • Excellent communication skills in English (C1).
  • Self-starter, organized, and comfortable with autonomy.

description:
Muito prazer, somos a United Hub!

Na UHub, somos impulsionados pelo propósito de liderar a transformação digital com excelência e agilidade. A flexibilidade é uma de nossas marcas registradas, permitindo-nos operar em uma variedade de modelos e formatos de equipe para proporcionar oportunidades de desenvolvimento e crescimento. Junte-se a nós enquanto abraçamos o futuro da tecnologia e trabalhamos juntos para alcançar novos patamares de sucesso.


O Que Você Vai Fazer

Estamos procurando um Desenvolvedor Front-End Sênior com especialização em Blazor e inglês avançado para o desenvolvimento de soluções robustas e escaláveis, utilizando as melhores práticas de codificação e design. As responsabilidades incluem desenvolver e manter componentes front-end, colaborar com desenvolvedores back-end, garantir design responsivo e contribuir em projetos de desenvolvimento de software. A função também envolve participar de revisões de código e fornecer orientação técnica para desenvolvedores juniores.


O Que Estamos Buscando

  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente;
  • 5+ anos de experiência Blazor;
  • 5+ anos de experiência TypeScript;
  • 5+ anos de experiência C#;
  • Testes unitários e testes de integração;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum)
  • Comunicação e trabalho em equipe;


Será Um Diferencial Se Você

  • Experiência com Azure DevOps;
  • Experiência com React e Angular


Onde Você Vai Trabalhar

  • Esta é uma posição para atuação 100% remota

  • PJ.

title: Operational Specialist
description:
Job Title: Operational Specialist & Executive Support


Client's Company Overview

We are a growing digital marketing agency managing multiple clients, campaigns, and internal workflows. We are seeking a highly organized individual to help structure operations, improve efficiency, and ensure execution across the business.


Hours: 20 hours/week to start and transition to full-time based on performance.


Responsibilities

  • Act as a central coordinator across the business , ensuring tasks and projects move forward
  • Manage and organize workflows within project management tools (e.g., ClickUp or similar)
  • Convert incoming requests (emails, client needs, files) into structured tasks and workflows
  • Upload, organize, and manage deliverables (e.g., CSV files, campaign assets)
  • Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
  • Track progress across team members (copywriter, PPC, leadership) and follow up as needed
  • Prepare meeting logistics:
  • Calendar management
  • Agendas and reminders
  • Help document business processes and improve operational structure
  • Identify inefficiencies and propose better workflows
  • Use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) to improve efficiency and documentation
  • Support leadership by maintaining visibility across all ongoing work


Qualifications

  • Experience supporting senior leadership, founders, or small teams
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills
  • Proven ability to create SOPs and structured workflows
  • High attention to detail and reliability (nothing falls through the cracks)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to think beyond task execution and understand business-level context
  • Comfortable using project management tools (ClickUp, Monday, Asana, etc.)
  • Proactive mindset with ownership mentality


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in digital marketing or agency environments
  • Familiarity with Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) or similar frameworks
  • Experience working with AI tools for workflow or documentation
  • Ability to think like a decision-maker (without necessarily making final decisions)
  • Experience helping teams become more organized and scalable

description:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.   • Opportunity is for a project that is ~2 week duration with potential extension

title: AI Python Developer
description:
Role Overview

Client is seeking highly skilled Python Software Engineers to support complex data workloads and AI‑driven systems . This role is ideal for engineers who are deeply hands‑on with Python and PySpark , comfortable working in production environments , and experienced contributing to or actively engaging with open‑source communities .

This position will focus on building production‑grade APIs, scalable data pipelines, and developer tooling , while collaborating across engineering, product, and data teams.

Top Requirement: Candidates must be very strong in Python and PySpark . This is non‑negotiable and should be the primary focus during technical screening.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop production‑grade Python services and APIs supporting AI and data platforms
  • Build and optimize PySpark workloads to support large‑scale data processing
  • Contribute to AI systems and complex data pipelines in production environments
  • Develop developer tooling to streamline the software delivery lifecycle
  • Implement observability, monitoring, and performance optimization strategies
  • Practice infrastructure‑as‑code and deployment automation
  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and data teams on architecture and system design
  • Participate in and contribute to technical discussions and design reviews


Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong Python expertise (primary language)
  • Strong PySpark experience working with large datasets
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience , primarily in Python
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering , or related field
  • Experience contributing to open‑source projects
  • Code contributions, PRs, or
  • Meaningful participation via issues, discussions, or proposals in major libraries (data science, ML, or LLM ecosystems)
  • Strong experience with Git and platforms such as GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket
  • Experience developing APIs using FastAPI
  • Experience with ML / data libraries such as Scikit‑Learn, TensorFlow , or similar
  • Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Experience with containers, orchestration systems, and serverless technologies
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate technical decisions clearly


Nice to Have

  • Experience with LangChain and/or LangFlow
  • Background supporting LLM‑based or AI‑driven applications
  • Experience building data‑intensive platforms in production
  • Exposure to distributed systems and large‑scale data architectures

title: Web Content Editor / Web QA (Growth Role)
description:
Location: Brazil

Team: Digital / Web


Company Description


Bucksense, Inc. is a company dedicated to bridging the gap between brands and publishers by fostering an open and trustworthy environment. We leverage creativity, skilled professionals, and advanced technology to drive marketing performance across multiple channels. Our services for brands empower businesses to take control of their digital marketing strategies, data, and outcomes, while our DirectoPub platform offers publishers innovative opportunities to optimize revenue. At Bucksense, we combine technology with human expertise to provide a unified platform for managing marketing operations effectively. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity.


Role Overview


We are seeking a digitally savvy, detail-oriented Web Content Editor with a strong interest in web quality assurance and UX excellence. This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time.


You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks.


You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience.


Key Responsibilities:


Content Editing & Publishing

  • Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines.
  • Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages.
  • Manage and update content within a CMS (e.g., Sanity, WordPress, or similar).
  • Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders.
  • Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates.


UX, Accessibility & Content Quality

  • Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization.
  • Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.g., alt text, content structure, readability).
  • Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization.
  • Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation.


Web QA & Quality Ownership

  • Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards.
  • Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues.
  • Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content.
  • Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership.


Performance & Optimization

  • Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics).
  • Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content.
  • Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review.


Qualifications & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations.
  • Strong editorial skills: writing, editing, and proofreading with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Hands-on experience working with CMS platforms (Sanity, WordPress, or headless CMS).
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments.
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices.
  • Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues.
  • Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance.
  • Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows.
  • Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time.


Nice to Have

  • Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes.
  • Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments.
  • Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists.


Growth Opportunity

This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

Our services for brands empower businesses to take control of their digital marketing strategies, data, and outcomes, while our DirectoPub platform offers publishers innovative opportunities to optimize revenue. At Bucksense, we combine technology with human expertise to provide a unified platform for managing marketing operations effectively. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity.


Role Overview


We are seeking a digitally savvy, detail-oriented Web Content Editor with a strong interest in web quality assurance and UX excellence. This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time.


You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks.


You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience.


Key Responsibilities:


Content Editing & Publishing

  • Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines.
  • Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages.
  • Manage and update content within a CMS (e.g., Sanity, WordPress, or similar).
  • Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders.
  • Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates.


UX, Accessibility & Content Quality

  • Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization.
  • Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.g., alt text, content structure, readability).
  • Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization.
  • Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation.


Web QA & Quality Ownership

  • Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards.
  • Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues.
  • Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content.
  • Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership.


Performance & Optimization

  • Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics).
  • Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content.
  • Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review.


Qualifications & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations.
  • Strong editorial skills: writing, editing, and proofreading with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Hands-on experience working with CMS platforms (Sanity, WordPress, or headless CMS).
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments.
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices.
  • Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues.
  • Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance.
  • Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows.
  • Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time.


Nice to Have

  • Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes.
  • Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments.
  • Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists.


Growth Opportunity

This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About IDP

At International Digital Partners (IDP) , we connect top global talent with fast-growing, innovative companies. We are a fully remote, multicultural team focused on delivering real value to our clients through technology, consulting, and digital execution. Our mission is to build world-class technical teams, and that’s where you come in.


About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Recruiter , highly experienced, self-driven, and multilingual, to join our international Talent Acquisition team. This is a key role in helping us scale technical teams across the U.S., Latin America, and Europe. You'll own full-cycle recruitment for high-demand technical roles.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the full recruitment life cycle for technical roles: intake, sourcing, interviewing, coordinating, and offer negotiation;
  • Screen and assess candidates, both on soft skills and basic technical fit;
  • Source talent proactively via LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, and other sourcing platforms;
  • Maintain clear, professional communication in English and Spanish.
  • Build and nurture a pipeline of high-quality candidates across multiple regions and time zones;
  • Ensure a seamless, positive candidate experience from first contact to onboarding;
  • Contribute to process improvement and employer branding initiatives.


Requirements

Must-Haves:

  • 3+ years of experience in technical recruiting, with proven success in international or remote hiring;
  • Solid understanding of tech stacks, tools, and roles (e.g., Frontend, Backend, Full Stack, DevOps, Data, QA);
  • Fluency (B2) in English is a must; Fluency in Spanish is highly preferred but not required
  • Experience using ATS platforms (e.g., Manatal, Greenhouse, Bullhorn) and sourcing tools like LinkedIn Recruiter;
  • Ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, multicultural environment;
  • Strong organizational and interpersonal skills, with a solution-oriented mindset.


Nice-to-Haves:

  • Background in tech consulting or staffing;
  • Experience hiring across LATAM, U.S., and Europe;
  • Knowledge of international hiring models (contracting, nearshoring, etc.);
  • Familiarity with Agile environments and distributed tech teams.


What We Offer

  • Fully remote, international working environment
  • Supportive, multicultural team and collaborative culture
  • Access to innovative global projects with high impact
  • Continuous learning and growth opportunities

title: OpenClaw Trajectory Specialist - 65130
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical business problems.


Role Overview:

We are looking for highly analytical professionals to join as S3 Annotators , responsible for producing and validating advanced OpenClaw trajectories for research-oriented tasks involving ambiguous goals, multi-step reasoning, and long-context workflows.


This role requires strong problem-solving ability, research thinking, and the capability to justify decisions while executing complex, multi-tool workflows used to train sophisticated AI agents.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Create and validate OpenClaw trajectories for complex, research-oriented tasks
  • Work on tasks such as data analysis, web research, and document synthesis
  • Operate under underspecified or ambiguous goals , making logical and defensible decisions
  • Use Python (notebooks, scripts) for data processing, automation, and analysis
  • Perform workflows spanning multiple tools, environments, and applications
  • Clearly document both what actions were taken and why they were taken
  • Review and improve trajectory quality for reasoning depth and correctness
  • Collaborate with teams to refine evaluation standards and annotation frameworks


Requirements:

  • Background in research, data science, engineering, or related fields (academic or industry)
  • 5+ years of experience in Python / Bash , including experience with notebooks and data wrangling
  • Experience with OpenClaw or similar advanced environments
  • Experience with web research, scraping tools, or data analysis workflows
  • Ability to articulate reasoning behind decisions and steps
  • Experience handling multi-step workflows across tools or platforms
  • Exposure to LLM-based tools, AI systems, or agentic workflows


Nice to Have:

  • Academic research experience (thesis, publications, lab work )
  • Familiarity with evaluation methodologies or experimental design
  • Experience in AI evaluation, RLHF, or advanced annotation workflows


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and a minimum of 20 hours per week, with a 4-hour overlap with PST.
  • Employment Type: Contractor position (Note: this role does not include medical/paid leave).
  • Duration of Contract: 5 weeks; (expected start date is next week).
  • Location: Remote (India, Brazil, Mexico, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Kenya, Egypt, Nigeria, Ghana, Turkey)


Evaluation Process:

  • Resume screening
  • Take home assessment (60 mins)



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Arquiteto de Soluções - Com Foco em IA
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:


No Grupo Fleury , acreditamos que o futuro da saúde será cada vez mais data-driven, inteligente e digital. Estamos construindo um ecossistema tecnológico que integra dados, inteligência artificial, automação e plataformas digitais, com o objetivo de transformar a jornada de cuidado em saúde.

Buscamos um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Soluções, que será responsável por projetar e evoluir soluções tecnológicas escaláveis que utilizem IA, dados e plataformas cloud para gerar impacto real no negócio.


Se você é apaixonado por arquitetura de sistemas, IA generativa, plataformas de dados e cloud computing, essa oportunidade é para você.


Principais desafios da posição:


• Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial, incluindo aplicações de Machine Learning, IA Generativa e automação inteligente.

• Projetar arquiteturas modernas baseadas em cloud-native architecture, microservices e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.

• Desenvolver soluções que integrem plataformas de dados, modelos de IA, APIs e sistemas corporativos.

• Atuar no desenho de soluções com Large Language Models (LLMs), GenAI, AI Agents e automação baseada em IA.

• Definir padrões de arquitetura para soluções que utilizem plataformas de IA em nuvem.

• Apoiar squads de engenharia no desenvolvimento de soluções com IA, dados e plataformas digitais.

• Garantir que as soluções atendam requisitos de segurança, governança de dados, escalabilidade e observabilidade.

• Avaliar novas tecnologias e frameworks emergentes no ecossistema de AI, Data e Cloud Architecture.


Tecnologias e plataformas com as quais você irá trabalhar:

A arquitetura da companhia envolve um ecossistema moderno de tecnologias, incluindo:

  • Cloud e Plataformas de IA
  • AWS (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, EKS, Aurora, API Gateway)
  • Microsoft Azure (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, AKS, Data Factory, Synapse)
  • Google Cloud Platform (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE)

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Python + React) — AI StartupSenior Full-Stack Engineer - AI Productivity Platform (Remote)
description:
Position: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (AI Platform)


About Us

We are a fast-growing AI startup transforming how professionals interact with complex information. We build enterprise-grade AI productivity platforms used by researchers, analysts, and engineers at large companies and rapidly scaling teams.

Our platform powers advanced AI workflows such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-agent systems, document intelligence, and structured data search — with a strong focus on reliability, security, and scalability in production environments.


Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to help design, build, and scale both the backend systems and frontend experiences of our AI platform. You will work across the entire stack — from Python-based AI orchestration services and data pipelines to the React-based interfaces that bring those capabilities to enterprise users every day.

This role is ideal for engineers who think end-to-end: you care about clean API design and reliable backend architecture, but you're equally motivated by building polished, responsive interfaces that make complex AI workflows feel intuitive.


Responsibilities


Backend & Platform

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services in Python
  • Develop and evolve RESTful and WebSocket APIs supporting AI workflows and enterprise use cases
  • Build and maintain AI orchestration layers (RAG pipelines, agent systems, retrieval modules)
  • Integrate multiple data sources: vector databases, structured/tabular data, files, and web search
  • Own backend architecture decisions with a strong focus on performance, security, and reliability


Frontend & User Experience

  • Build and iterate on production React interfaces using Next.js and TypeScript
  • Translate complex AI capabilities into clean, usable UI patterns — from research dashboards to interactive data views
  • Implement real-time features such as streaming responses, live status indicators, and dynamic content updates
  • Ensure frontend performance, accessibility, and responsiveness across devices


Cross-Cutting

  • Collaborate closely with AI/ML, Design, and Product teams to ship features end-to-end
  • Implement observability, monitoring, logging, and automated testing across the stack
  • Debug and trace issues from the UI through the API layer to backend services
  • Participate in code reviews and help raise the overall engineering bar


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional engineering experience shipping production software
  • Strong proficiency in Python with experience building backend services (FastAPI or similar)
  • Strong proficiency in React with experience in Next.js and TypeScript
  • Solid understanding of API design, state management, and component architecture
  • Hands-on experience with AWS (e.g. Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB)
  • Experience with relational and non-relational databases
  • Comfort working across the full stack — you don't need to be told where the problem is
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and production deployment workflows
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a distributed team


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, or AI agent systems
  • Familiarity with vector databases and semantic search (e.g. OpenSearch)
  • Experience with real-time interfaces (WebSockets, streaming, SSE)
  • Background in enterprise SaaS platforms
  • Experience with Vercel for frontend hosting and deployment
  • Knowledge of authentication systems (e.g. Clerk, Auth0)
  • Knowledge of security best practices and compliance (SOC 2 is a plus)
  • Experience working with high-scale or high-availability systems


What We Offer

  • Work on cutting-edge AI systems used by enterprise customers
  • High-impact role with ownership across the full stack
  • Flexible remote work (Worldwide)
  • Direct collaboration with experienced engineers and founders
  • Fast-paced environment with real production challenges
  • Strong influence on technical and product decisions


Location Remote (Worldwide)

Hiring Model Contractor


How to Apply Please reply here with your CV or portfolio. If you enjoy building serious full-stack systems for real AI products — from the Python services that power intelligent workflows to the React interfaces that put them in users' hands — we'd love to hear from you.

title: Full Stack Ruby Engineer
description:
Full Stack Ruby Engineer


Our Client's Company: Our client's company is a healthcare technology company that provides convenient, in-home physical therapy by connecting patients with licensed therapists and delivering personalized care through a tech-enabled platform.


Role Overview:

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Full Stack Engineer with deep Ruby expertise to lead development on our core API and front-end systems. You will own high-impact features across our healthcare technology platform, with a focus on third-party integrations, robust backend logic, and intuitive frontend user experiences. This is a high-visibility engineering role with end-to-end ownership and the opportunity to shape the product roadmap.


Responsibilities:

Backend (Ruby, Sinatra)

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable APIs and automation services using Ruby (Sinatra framework).
  • Lead development of complex integrations with third-party services such as Zoho CRM/Desk, Clinicient EMR, Stripe, DropboxSign, and AWS S3.
  • Manage data workflows and background processing using Rake tasks and ActiveRecord.
  • Optimize system performance and resolve bottlenecks in data-heavy environments.
  • Uphold best practices in code structure, security (HIPAA compliance), testing (RSpec), and maintainability.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions including data modeling and service boundaries.
  • Operate within a GitLab CI/CD and Docker containerization environment.


Frontend (React, JS)

  • Build and maintain dynamic user-facing components using React.js and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Ensure responsive, cross-browser-compatible UI with clean HTML5/CSS3 implementation.
  • Integrate front-end features with RESTful backend services.
  • Debug and resolve frontend performance and usability issues.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of full-stack development experience with a strong backend focus.
  • Expert-level Ruby developer; hands-on experience with Sinatra or Rails.
  • Solid understanding of object-oriented design and architecture patterns (e.g., Service Objects).
  • Strong PostgreSQL skills: schema design, complex queries, and performance tuning.
  • Deep experience with RESTful APIs and background job frameworks.
  • Proven RSpec test coverage practices; TDD mindset.
  • Proficient in React.js and ES6+ JavaScript.
  • Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD workflows, Docker.
  • Detail-oriented, security-minded, and comfortable working in healthcare-compliant environments.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in healthcare tech or HIPAA-compliant environments.
  • Familiarity with Clinicient, Zoho CRM/Desk, Stripe, DropboxSign, AWS S3.
  • Understanding of caching strategies and optimizing high-throughput systems.
  • Experience with TypeScript, performance profiling, or analytics instrumentation.
  • Leverage AI tools to support frontend development.


What We Offer

  • Fully remote, flexible working environment.
  • Mission-driven culture focused on improving healthcare delivery.
  • Opportunity to lead and grow within a fast-moving, high-impact startup.
  • Collaborative, engineering-led product development process.

title: Data Engineer - SALESFORCE
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Job Description

Data Engineer - with Salesforce integration experience and strong ETL expertise in Azure‑based environments

Data Extraction - Extract legacy data from SQL Server using Azure Synapse / Azure Data Factory

Salesforce Loads - Load, validate, and reconcile data into Salesforce platforms

Quality & Testing - Conduct unit testing and support UAT

Delivery - Manage work items, defects, and priorities in Jira

Standards - Contribute to reusable migration processes and playbooks


Required skills

Data Mapping - Develop and implement source‑to‑target mappings aligned to Salesforce data models


Preferred/Desired skills

title: Senior Oracle Engineer
description:
Required Skills & Experience


• 5+ years of experience as an Oracle Engineer or Oracle DBA with DevOps experience

• Strong hands-on Oracle engineering (looking for experience developing ansible playbooks and designing within the Oracle Database)

• Experience working in complex, enterprise environments

• DevOps experience including Ansible and Linux administration

• Experience supporting or leading large database migrations

• Strong communication skills and ability to work across global teams

• Comfortable in a fast-moving, flexible environment

Eagerness to learn new technologies and stay current


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Additional migration experience

• Exposure to AI initiatives

Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, PostgreSQL, or Terraform


Job Description


A global enterprise company is seeking a Senior Oracle Engineer to join their team! This role is heavily focused on engineering and project-based work rather than daily operational support. The Senior Oracle Engineer will design and build processes that are handed off to other teams, define repeatable operational workflows, and play a key role in a large migration initiative. Responsibilities include performance tuning, backups, server builds, patching, and ensuring overall platform stability while maintaining strong DBA fundamentals. The role also involves contributing to development and build work, primarily supporting Oracle environments with limited exposure to PostgreSQL and oversight support for MySQL. The team operates in an Agile environment using Jira and collaborates closely with software engineers, testers, application specialists, and operations teams. The engineer will help ensure systems are designed consistently and provide incident support when needed. This role is based in Brazil, follows a standard 40-hour work week with occasional on-call rotation, and the permanent salary range is R$623,781.00.

title: Cybersecurity Customer Success Manager - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.


Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Role Overview:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK, you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions. Your role will involve deep engagement with clients, providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products. Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.


Your mission->

I. Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

II. Cybersecurity Expertise:

  • Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues.
  • Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform.
  • Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.

III. Customer Engagement:

  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs.
  • Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals.
  • Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.

IV. Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services.
  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.
  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

V. Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

VI. Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.


What we're looking for:

  • 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients.
  • Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.


Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:

  • Business reviews
  • Onsite meetings
  • Maintaining NRR and GRR
  • Threat analysis and Value delivery


Benefits of Joining CloudSEK

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:

  • Flexible working hours.
  • Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!


CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
